title: QEx EDGE-source QVert detection on numerical stage2 UVs (1 found vs metriko's ~3000)
description:
Surfaced during PATCH-62. Our QuadVertexGenerator EDGE pass finds 1 EDGE QVert on Hand-30k stage2 UVs vs metriko's ~3000 EDGE-on-edge integer points. Tighter COLLINEAR_EPS (1e-4) excludes most candidates; looser EPS (1e-2) finds 221 but they're noisy false positives that DECREASE final quad count.

The fundamental issue: stage2's UVs come from a numerical IGM solve. Mesh edges that should pass through integer (u, v) points typically pass within ~1e-3 of them, NOT exactly through. metriko's reference still emits ~3000 EDGE QVerts somehow — either:

1. metriko uses a different EPS scaled to mesh-edge length.
2. metriko emits a candidate at EVERY integer crossing of an iso-line through the surface, computed differently from our 'iterate integer points in segment bbox + collinearity test' approach.
3. metriko's QEx generates EDGE QVerts via a different mechanism (maybe lifted from per-corner UV interpolation along the edge rather than testing each integer point).

To debug:
- Print metriko's actual EPS_collinearity used in is_collinear() in /tmp/metriko/include/metriko/core/common/utilities.h.
- Compare metriko's EDGE QVert count distribution to ours at matching EPS.
- Try emitting EDGE QVerts via 'find integer u-isoline crossings of the edge segment' (parametric, not enumerate-integer-bbox).

Once EDGE QVert generation is fixed, the empirical QEdge/quad count should track with QVert count, and the >50% bar from PATCH-61 should be reachable.
definition-of-done: MetrikoStageRegressionTest.stage2UvsThroughQexProducesQuads reports our_quad_count > 1170 (>50% of metriko's 2339). Existing 78 quadlayout tests still pass.
testing-plan: 1. Read metriko's EPS constant. 2. Reimplement EDGE pass with parametric isoline-crossing instead of integer-bbox enumeration. 3. Verify EDGE QVert count is order-of-magnitude similar to metriko's (estimate from quad count: ~3000).
